title: Insisto
notes: Psych-tinged indie rock with unsettling lyrics, guitar feedback and occasional funk.

title: Rosa spinto
scene: Late-1990s Italian alternative dance / Roman indie

title: Illusioni parallele
scene: Italian alternative pop with performed-and-resampled electronics

title: L’alba di domani
